tier1.text: The vertebral column, or spine, supports the head and body and protects the spinal cord. The spine is a series of bones, called vertebrae, that runs from the skull to the tailbone. Pads called intervertebral discs sit between the vertebrae and let the spine move. The adult spine has four curves, which add strength and flexibility and help absorb shock.

sentences.text: The vertebral column, or spine, supports the head and body and protects the spinal cord.

quotes.quote: Together, the vertebrae and intervertebral discs form the vertebral column. It is a flexible column that supports the head, neck, and body and allows for their movements. It also protects the spinal cord, which passes down the back through openings in the vertebrae.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: The vertebral column is also known as the spinal column or spine
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The spine is a series of bones, called vertebrae, that runs from the skull to the tailbone.

quotes.quote: vertebral column: entire sequence of bones that extend from the skull to the tailbone
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: vertebra: individual bone in the neck and back regions of the vertebral column
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: Pads called intervertebral discs sit between the vertebrae and let the spine move.

quotes.quote: intervertebral disc: structure located between the bodies of adjacent vertebrae that strongly joins the vertebrae; provides padding, weight bearing ability, and enables vertebral column movements
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: The adult spine has four curves, which add strength and flexibility and help absorb shock.

quotes.quote: The adult vertebral column does not form a straight line, but instead has four curvatures along its length (see ). These curves increase the vertebral column’s strength, flexibility, and ability to absorb shock.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
